scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “A spectral gap throughout the high-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick phase” (preprints/A-spectral-gap-throughout-the-high-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-phase-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 227 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d1eccdc9781a9cf3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a finite constant Cβ, depending only on β, such that PJ {Varµ0 (f) ≤ CβD0(f) for every f : {−1, 1}n −→ R} −→ 1. Consequently, the discrete-time heat-bath chain that chooses a uniform site has spectral gap at least 1/(Cβn) with probability tending to one.
